title: Buccaneers vs. Panthers: Baker Mayfield expected back as three Bucs ruled out

sources.title: Buccaneers vs. Panthers: Baker Mayfield expected back as three Bucs ruled out
sources.description: The Tampa Bay Buccaneers received encouraging news regarding quarterback Baker Mayfield Friday, but will be without several key players for Sunday’s NFC South matchup against the Carolina Panthers. Mayfield, who has missed the last three games with a dislocated right thumb, practiced fully for the third consecutive day. Although officially listed as questionable, head coach […]
